rationale: The task requests changes to existing user-visible disclosure and TUI warning behavior and addresses version drift. With no approved, durable UR and no Brownfield decision, the earliest permissible stage is UR; later stages and implementation remain fail-closed.
decision_grounds: The requested work changes user-visible disclosure and TUI warning behavior and therefore requires a durable UR before a
Control-state context explicitly states that no approval or Brownfield decision is present.
No delivery path can be evaluated before an approved durable UR and completed Brownfield Review with an evidenced Mode/S
